answer: Offer a turncoat bounty. Any seat that proves it shares an operator with other seats, by signing a fresh challenge with their keys, keeps its own seat and half of their forfeited stakes. Payouts are sealed, so the farmer can't learn which copy turned. Every clone is a mirror of the same reasoning and sees the same offer each epoch, so a farm stays whole only if all of them refuse. Even a copper-sized stake per seat sums to a big prize for the first to defect, and that sable doubt keeps fleets small.
